claimBoundary: Pre-registered physical-TV appliance behavior campaign only. No television, port, cable, receiver, display, audio, HDMI-CEC, sleep, wake, input-switch, hot-plug, controller-recovery, reliability, target, or product result exists. Browser pixels, EDID or ELD state, compositor state, an audio API event, CEC traffic, and a running launcher cannot establish physical picture, audible output, user control, or recovery.
sourceDigestContract: SHA-256 over strict UTF-8 after CRLF-to-LF normalization; bare carriage returns are rejected

targets.idleStrategyBoundary: Q-270 must select platform suspend or low-power launcher idle for the exact ordinary-Linux tuple before execution.
D-095 requires measured low-power launcher idle unless reliable Raspberry Pi suspend is separately proven and selected.
D-095 assigns suspend to Steam Machine, but D-119 keeps this target optional and unable to rescue either common target.

scenarios.requiredOutcome: The approved wake source restores a physically visible and audible controller-usable launcher inside the fixed warm-wake deadline without bypassing quiescence or privacy gates.
Television standby and return cannot create a false active state, leave capture or a game ambiguous, lose audio, or remove controller and physical recovery.
A deliberate switch away is respected and return restores the exact display and audio route without focus fighting, repeated commands, or an unusable shell.
The console does not fight an external source, claim success from CEC traffic alone, or retake input until the approved deliberate user action.
Loss and restoration of the direct-TV stereo route is reported honestly and returns correct left and right audible output without clipping, dropout, or stale routing.
Changing to another approved output and back never lets an optional receiver rescue direct-TV failure and preserves a controller-usable recovery path.
Physical HDMI removal and reinsertion reacquires fresh display, audio, and CEC state before use and restores a safe controller-operable mode without a blind loop.
Hot-plug at launcher, loading, running-game, failure, and idle boundaries cannot manufacture readiness or strand the appliance without Back, Home, or physical fallback.
